text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, far from subsiding, Mejiro 
Dober feels power surging within her 
instead of trembling, and she is filled 
with joyous courage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having overcome her fears and grown 
immensely, Mejiro Dober is already firing 
up her fighting spirit for the Shuka 
Sho...!
